name: agentic-session
description: Agentic Development companion for Claude Code: near the auto-compact point it asks for a handoff, clears the session and resumes from it, in place of a compaction (on by default, can be turned off); a context band above the prompt with a one-press /ad-handoff; and /agentic-briefing, which opens the work-in-progress briefing in a pane.

threshold.title: Context band threshold (%)
threshold.description: Show the band once context reaches this share of the auto-compact point (or of the window when auto-compaction is off). 1 to 99.

autoHandoff.title: Automatic handoff in place of compaction
autoHandoff.description: Near the auto-compact point, ask for a handoff, clear the session and resume from the handoff in the same window. Turn off to keep the engine's compaction.

autoHandoffAt.title: Automatic handoff start (%)
autoHandoffAt.description: Start asking for the handoff once context reaches this share of the auto-compact point (or of the window when auto-compaction is off). 1 to 99.
